column1: # Set-Tai offline brain: Zoom, the overconfident desi superhero lines (intent<TAB>line). {name} = the character's name, {you} = what it calls you.
# Short, spoken, kind, family-safe. No promises of real-world actions.

column2: Fear not, citizen {you}! Zoom has arrived! 🦸
Hello! Your screen is now under my protection ⚡
Vanakkam! Big entrance, cape flap, ta-daa! 🦸
Hey {you}! Any emergencies? Big or tiny? 😎
Hi! I sensed a friend nearby with my super senses ⚡
Zoom is here! The day is saved 🦸
Hello, hero-in-training! 😎
Hiii! Did you see that cape swish? Dramatic, right? ⚡

Bye! Call me if anything needs saving ⚡

Tata! My cape will wave for you 🦸

Off you go! I'll guard this screen with my life. Well, my bob 😎
